# Identity Approval Requirements Quality Checklist: Cueson

**Purpose**: Review whether S026 requirements are complete, precise, and internally consistent enough to prevent product misrepresentation, unapproved identity work, inaccessible color, stale approval, premature publication, and excess review rounds.
**Created**: 2026-09-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Product and Concept Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are the authoritative Cueson evidence sources and the default-branch revision rules defined completely? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is the distinction between factual screenshot content and prohibited visual precedent unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Do the identity criteria cover timed language, common structure, format breadth, source preservation, bitmap input, derived OCR, and explicit loss diagnostics? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 Are the required concept count, proof sizes, surfaces, analyses, risks, and tradeoffs specified for every Gate 1 candidate? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK005 Are prohibited generic motifs explicit without blocking a genuinely distinctive treatment that happens to use a related primitive? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK006 Can the requirement that concepts be materially distinct be reviewed against the stated identity criteria rather than subjective naming alone? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Verbal Identity and Affiliation

- [x] CHK007 Are the exact name, slogan, description, preferred line break, and one-line exception defined without competing variants? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004 through FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Is ShruggieTech ownership separated clearly from product-specific identity, palette, and geometry decisions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Are parent-brand inheritance, endorsement, service-credit, and showcase expectations complete enough for source and generated surfaces? [Completeness, Contract §Source and Consumer Handoff]

## Color and Accessibility

- [x] CHK010 Does Gate 1 require a complete semantic color system rather than an isolated accent swatch? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK011 Are light, dark, single-ink, contrast, color-vision, and parent-role relationships all required with measurable evidence? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK012 Is the no-waiver WCAG 2.1 AA floor consistent across concept, derivative, generated kit, and public-surface requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024 and SC-006]
- [x] CHK013 Are identity and operational state colors required to remain distinguishable by more than hue alone? [Coverage, Data Model §Color-System Candidate]

## Approval and Revision Semantics

- [x] CHK014 Is explicit approval distinguished from critique, partial approval, silence, questions, and a request for improvement at both gates? [Clarity, Contract §Identity Approval]
- [x] CHK015 Are candidate identifiers, exact hashes, displayed evidence, owner wording, identity, timestamp, scope, and supersession requirements complete for both gates? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012 and FR-018]
- [x] CHK016 Is approval staleness defined for product evidence, geometry, palette, typography, producing configuration, derivative manifest, and public-surface drift? [Recovery, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK017 Is the return path to the earliest affected gate explicit when approved inputs drift or review feedback requires identity change? [Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Derived Spread and Production Boundary

- [x] CHK018 Does Gate 2 enumerate every current lockup, wordmark, copy, colorway, reduced, platform, social, repository, specimen, and raster family? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK019 Are source relationships, hashes, masks, crops, dimensions, spacing, clear space, and minimum-size evidence required for every affected derivative? [Traceability, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK020 Is Gate 1 explicitly prevented from authorizing typography, wordmark construction, icon crops, reduced geometry, or final applications? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK021 Are generated proposal evidence, committed production source, generated kit output, and public eligibility separated without an ambiguous intermediate state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, FR-017, FR-020, and FR-023]

## Handoff, Publication, and Review

- [x] CHK022 Does the consumer handoff requirement identify exact assets, hashes, destinations, licenses, later workflow, and unchanged Cueson/domain state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028 through FR-029]
- [x] CHK023 Are the authorized push and pull-request exception and the still-prohibited merge, release, deployment, consumer-import, and domain actions mutually consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029 through FR-030]
- [x] CHK024 Is every CI, security, Codex, and human review disposition required while the Codex request count is capped unambiguously at two rounds? [Coverage, Spec §FR-031 through FR-032]
- [x] CHK025 Are passive-SVG, path-containment, network-reference, dependency, and output-hygiene security requirements explicit, and is tenancy correctly scoped as inapplicable because the slice introduces no tenant-bearing runtime? [Coverage, Plan §Technical Context]

## Notes

- Final requirements-quality review completed on 2026-09-09 after both owner approvals, consumer-boundary generation, and local verification. All 25 criteria are satisfied without treating these markers as implementation state.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline and link to relevant evidence.
